schema:name: Merry Vintners Wine Label 1984 Sonoma County Chardonnay
schema:creator: Edwards, Merry
schema:description: Merry Vintners wine label for the 1984 vintage of Sonoma County chardonnay. Label is in color and size is 4 inches x 7 inches and features an image captured by UC Davis viticulture and enology professor Dr. Ralph Kunkee. This vintage won a gold medal at the 1986 National Wine Competition in San Diego. Merry Edwards founded Merry Vintners in 1984 and it existed until the late 1980s.
